attchmntText: TITAGARH RAIL SYSTEMS LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
voiceSummary: Titagarh Rail Systems Limited received a Letter of Acceptance from Chittaranjan Locomotive Works for the supply of 3-Phase Asynchronous Traction Motors, Type 6FRA-6068, for WAG-9 locomotives. The order is valued at 65.38 crores including GST. This contract marks the first successful award under the company's upgraded Vendor Status Category to Regular Source by Indian Railways. The approved manufacturing capacity for these motors is 1,200 units per annum. Execution of the order is scheduled to be completed phase-wise by 31.12.2027. The entity awarding the contract is a domestic entity. There is no interest held by promoters or group companies in the awarding entity, and the transaction does not fall under related party transactions.

voiceSummary: Titagarh Rail Systems Limited has disclosed the transcript of its Q2 and H1FY27 earnings call held on 13th November 2026 at 04:00 P.M. attchmntText: TITAGARH RAIL SYSTEMS LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Titagarh Rail Systems Limited filed its Q2 and H1 FY27 investor presentation for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The company reported record Passenger Rail Systems revenue of Rs. 300 Crore, a 146% year-on-year increase. Fifty-one metro cars were invoiced, marking a 325% year-on-year rise. Freight Rail Systems revenue stood at Rs. 472.63 Crore. The standalone order book, including wagon order supply, is approximately Rs. 15,369 Crore. The total order book, including the pro-rata share of joint ventures, is approximately Rs. 28,695 Crore. A joint venture agreement with Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited was signed on 15th September 2026 for the maintenance of Vande Bharat sleeper trainsets. A memorandum of understanding was also signed with Siemens to explore international metro rolling stock opportunities.

attchmntText: TITAGARH RAIL SYSTEMS LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Titagarh Rail Systems Limited filed its Q2 and H1 FY27 Investor Presentation for the quarter ended 30th September, 2026, with the BSE and NSE. The company reported record Passenger Rail Systems revenue of Rs. 300 Crore, a 146% year-on-year increase. Fifty-one metro cars were invoiced, marking a 325% year-on-year rise. The standalone order book stood at approximately Rs. 15,369 Crore, while the total order book including joint venture shares reached approximately Rs. 28,695 Crore. A joint venture agreement with BHEL was signed on 15th September, 2026, for the maintenance of Vande Bharat sleeper trainsets. An MoU was also signed with Siemens to explore international metro opportunities. A new design centre commenced operations in Lucknow.

attchmntText: TITAGARH RAIL SYSTEMS LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Titagarh Rail Systems Limited published its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 in the Financial Express and Ekdin newspapers on 12th November 2026. The consolidated net profit after tax for the quarter was 63.44 crore rupees, compared to 47.29 crore rupees in the same period last year. For the half year, the consolidated net profit after tax was 115.43 crore rupees, compared to 36.08 crore rupees in the previous year. The results were approved by the Board of Directors on 10th November 2026. Burnpur Cement Limited also published its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The consolidated net loss after tax for the quarter was 2,231.42 crore rupees, compared to a loss of 1,939.88 crore rupees in the same period last year. For the half year, the consolidated net loss after tax was 4,388.03 crore rupees, compared to a loss of 3,835.92 crore rupees in the previous year. The results were approved by the Board of Directors on 11th November 2026.
